categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Docs' label and exclusively adds 'doc/error-handling.md'.
categories.rationale: Establishing a unified error-handling strategy addresses recurring ad-hoc debates stalling design decisions across PRs. The description notes that Bitcoin Core lacks an error-handling strategy, leading to repeated debates across validation and subsystem PRs and blocking architectural guidance for PRs such as #34931, #35003, and #34132.
